lanes.label: Formal knowledge checks

lanes.technicalReachability: 30/30 approved technical items are reachable across repeated learner-scoped least-exposed blueprint-balanced forms.

intentionallyNotMerged.reason: Book chapter checks remain attached to the governed teaching context they assess.
Lesson exercises remain attached to their Academy lesson context.
Optional material practice remains inside its specialist material-learning surface rather than competing with the five primary Question Centre lanes.

governanceBoundary: This manifest centralises discovery only. Question text, answer keys, feedback, evidence, scoring, human-review status and release authority remain owned by their canonical subsystems. The 45-question chapter-balanced material-science bank is formative learning content outside the 169 governed prompt total; listing it here does not create independent approval, qualification evidence or production authority.

canonicalEntryPoint.label: Question Centre
canonicalEntryPoint.presentation: One learner-facing surface inside Learn, with five governed question modes, a separate chapter-balanced formative material-science check and a related optional specialist-lessons shortcut.
canonicalEntryPoint.desktop: Learn > Question Centre; Knowledge Checks remains a direct formal-assessment route

supplementalQuestionSets.scoring: Formative local learning feedback only; each attempt covers all nine chapters and does not enter regional certification or the governed assessment count
